pairs.ask: How does the story go out?

optionA.label: Thread of story cards
optionA.desc: Five posts in a row, one picture each. People scroll the tale in order. Shown here: posts 1, 2 and 5.

optionB.label: One post, four pictures
optionB.desc: Everything in a single post with a 4-image set. One tap, whole story.

pairs.ask: Which first line stops the scroll?

optionA.label: "Born lucky"
optionA.desc: Sets up the twist: the luck had to be earned.

optionB.label: "Favorite of the gods"
optionB.desc: Cheeky and confident, with the tiger as the punchline.

pairs.ask: Which look for the story pictures?

optionA.label: Storybook, painterly
optionA.desc: Warm paper texture and soft painted edges, like an old picture book. Machan stays exactly on-model.

optionB.label: Clean, flat brand scenes
optionB.desc: Crisp shapes in the brand colours, matching my avatar and banner.

pairs.ask: How much tiger do we show?

optionA.label: Show the tiger
optionA.desc: He is right there in the lane, big and sure of himself.

optionB.label: Only his shadow
optionB.desc: A long striped shadow across the lane. Scarier, and more of a fairy tale.

optionA.label: Titles on the pictures
optionA.desc: Each picture carries a short chapter title. Works even if people only look at the images.

optionB.label: Words only in the post
optionB.desc: Clean pictures; the telling stays in the text.

pairs.ask: The story ends on my wink. Which kind?

optionA.label: Animated wink (GIF)
optionA.desc: A short loop: eyes open, a wink, eyes open again. Plays right in the feed.

optionB.label: Still wink with a caption
optionB.desc: One clean frame of the wink, with the last line written on it.

pairs.ask: A little Thai, or keep it all English?

optionA.label: A few Thai words
optionA.desc: Opens with สวัสดีครับ (hello) and calls me a ลูกพลับ (persimmon). Small and friendly.

optionB.label: English only
optionB.desc: Simple and universal for a first post.

optionA.label: Fable narrator
optionA.desc: "Once, in the hills..." Classic fairy-tale telling, about me.

optionB.label: Me, telling my own story
optionB.desc: First person, playful, a little mischievous. Sounds like a character, not a book.

pairs.ask: Point people somewhere at the end?

optionA.label: Link to a public story page (to be made)
optionA.desc: Ends with a link card to a public Machan story page we would build first. Placeholder shown; no live link yet.

optionB.label: No link
optionB.desc: The post is the whole story. Nothing to click away to.

pairs.ask: Short and sharp, or the longer telling?

optionA.label: Short
optionA.desc: Two lines and a wink. Fits easily under the 280-character limit.

optionB.label: Longer telling
optionB.desc: The full tale in one long post with "Show more". Over 280 characters needs X Premium; otherwise it becomes a thread.
